Best of New Wave Theater Volume 1

New Wave Theater was a TV show out of Los Angeles that got syndicated over USA Network's "Night Flight" in the early 80s. It's a very bizarre show that highlighted tons of punk & New Wave bands of that era (especially West Coast bands). The host, Peter Ivers, is a real weirdo--Harvard grad and composer for the film Eraserhead. He was beaten to death with a hammer in 1983. This particular video has some really interesting bands (and a couple that stink). The Blasters are still a major cult band. The Plugz morphed into The Cruzados and have remained famous (and are the house band in From Dusk till Dawn). The Suburban Lawns were a highly influential Art-rock/New Wave band that were got on Saturday Night Live, but disappeared after one album and one EP (their female singer is fucking cute). This is a really odd time-capsule of a show; worth checking out if you like that style music or just weird shit.
